_comment: Canonical NAP for Sunrise Roofers LLC. Single source of truth for every citation, directory listing and schema block. If a value changes here it must change everywhere - run `node scripts/check-nap.mjs` to verify.
name: Sunrise Roofers LLC

address.oneLine: 7320 N La Cholla Blvd Ste 154-276, Tucson, AZ 85741

phone._note: Destination line. CallRail swaps this dynamically on the site. NEVER use 520-783-3976 (GBP-bound) in paid ads; the ads call asset is 520-210-5284.

descriptions.short: Licensed Tucson roofing contractor (ROC #358079) handling tile, shingle and flat roofs across Pima County.
descriptions.medium: Sunrise Roofers LLC is a licensed and bonded roofing contractor serving Tucson, Marana, Oro Valley, Sahuarita, Green Valley and Vail. Owners Eddie and Viky Guillen handle tile roof repair, shingle and metal roof replacement, flat roof coatings, skylights and gutters, with free inspections and honest estimates. ROC #358079.
